bug_report_content:
id: 725
status: Fixed
summary: Properties defined on any record type applying to unrelated record types
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 0
commentCount: 3
Comment 0 (2012-05-12): Consider the following code: /** @typedef {{name: string, id: number}} */ var RecordType1; /** * @param {RecordType1} rec */ var func = function(rec) { alert(rec.name2); }; func({name: 'jim', id: 0}); Compiled with: java -jar build/compiler.jar --compilation_level=ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS --jscomp_error=accessControls --jscomp_error=checkTypes --jscomp_error=checkVars --js ~/Desktop/test.js Properly errors: /Users/dolapo/Desktop/test.js:9: ERROR - Property name2 never defined on rec alert(rec.name2); However, add another recordtype with name2 defined: /** @typedef {{name: string, id: number}} */ var RecordType1; /** @typedef {{name2: string}} */ var RecordType2; /** * @param {RecordType1} rec */ var func = function(rec) { alert(rec.name2); }; func({name: 'jim', id: 0}); and this compiles with no errors.
Comment 2 (2012-05-22): This issue was closed by revision r1984.
